environment.description: Kubernetes pod running in namespace 'data-pipeline' with default service mesh configuration. The Go binary serves HTTP directly on port 8080 behind a basic TCP load balancer (AWS NLB) with no L7 inspection. No response header modification is performed by any intermediate proxy. Kafka topic 'encrypted-events' accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the cluster.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP mode, no header injection)
config.kafka_acl: producer write access granted to 15 service accounts
